theme_strategy: Warm Educational Tech & Tactical Minimalist Hybrid (Clean, readable off-white light mode for high-density dashboards + deep graphite high-contrast kiosk mode with biometric overlay)

typography.anti_default_rules: Do NOT use Inter for main section headings or metric callouts. Use Plus Jakarta Sans (bold/extra-bold, tight tracking -0.02em) for Headings and JetBrains Mono for codes, timestamps, coordinates, and invoices.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100

colors.palette_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1 & 2 HYBRID: Warm Trust & Performance Tactical (Emerald Navy & Emerald Sage)
colors.contrast_rules: All normal text must meet WCAG AA >= 4.5:1. Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use backdrop-blur with minimum 80% opacity fill.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.kiosk_camera_view: relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border-2 border-teal-500/50 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(15,118,110,0.2)] bg-black
visual_enhancers.face_recognition_overlay: absolute inset-0 border-2 border-dashed border-teal-400/70 rounded-full animate-pulse flex items-center justify-center
visual_enhancers.geofence_status_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide
visual_enhancers.invoice_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium

layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layouts.kiosk_mobile_layout: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between p-4 sm:p-6 bg-slate-950 text-white
layouts.sidebar_navigation: fixed lg:static inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 w-64 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between border-r border-slate-800

motion.toast_sonner: Use sonner for instant feedback on offline sync, face recognition match, and invoice generation
motion.accessibility_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query across all animations.

accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, input, toggle, table row, dropdown, and tab MUST have a role-based kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='kiosk-check-in-button', data-testid='tenant-school-select').
accessibility.voice_feedback: Provide web SpeechSynthesis voice feedback in Indonesian ('Absensi berhasil', 'Wajah tidak cocok', 'Liveness gagal', 'Diluar lokasi sekolah') with mute/unmute audio button.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use lightweight SVG dynamic radar / canvas liveness ring instead of heavy WebGL to guarantee fast load on mid-range school smartphones & tablet kiosks.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST write clean .js files using React components and standard Tailwind classes.
Do NOT use Inter for main titles or primary metrics. Use Plus Jakarta Sans.
Always support both ID (Bahasa Indonesia) and EN (English) via a clean header language toggle component.
Default language MUST be Bahasa Indonesia ('id').
Every page MUST contain clear layout headers, responsive mobile navigation, and active role switchers (Platform Owner, School Admin, Teacher, Kiosk Mode).
Kiosk Mode MUST be mobile-first optimized for vertical phone viewports (100vh height layout, touch friendly controls).
All forms and interactive inputs MUST use data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use full transparent backgrounds on menus, overlays, or popovers.
Include Tripay payment simulator dialog & automatic PDF/WhatsApp invoice trigger feedback in billing sections.
instructions_to_main_agent: Read this design_guidelines.json configuration to apply exact theme tokens, font rules, layout structures, and test attributes across all SaaS views (Platform Owner, School Admin, Teacher Portal, Mobile Kiosk, and Billing/Tripay).
